label: Cutting at proved equivalences
subgoals: Pick an internal pair already proved equivalent
Replace both nodes by one shared free variable
Check the downstream logic with the cut in place

label: False negatives
subgoals: Identify two cut variables that the real logic correlates
Construct a cut assignment the real logic cannot produce
Show how that assignment yields an output difference

label: Resolving false negatives
subgoals: Simulate the counterexample's inputs on the uncut designs
Report a real difference or classify the counterexample as spurious
Remove or move the cuts the spurious counterexample used and re-solve
